verdict.rationale: Moss has a pricing page that mentions plans, and it states that all plans include unlimited local queries. Its runtime model (embedded SDK running in-browser, on-device or in the cloud, with no vector database to stand up) suggests developers do not provision fixed clusters. However, nothing shows usage-based billing or published per-unit rates. missing for 10: documented usage-based or serverless billing model, transparent per-unit prices (e.g., per query, per document, per GB), details of cloud-side metering, independent corroboration of pricing.
